items.title: Wynn Resorts Says 21,000 Employees Affected by ShinyHunters Hack
items.description: The high-end casino and hotel operator has likely paid a ransom to avoid a data leak. The post Wynn Resorts Says 21,000 Employees Affected by ShinyHunters Hack appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Flowise AI Agent Builder Under Active CVSS 10.0 RCE Exploitation; 12,000+ Instances Exposed
items.description: Threat actors are exploiting a maximum-severity security flaw in Flowise, an open-source artificial intelligence (AI) platform, according to new findings from VulnCheck. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2025-59528 (CVSS score: 10.0), a code injection vulnerability that could result in remote code execution.
